name: Inspector
notes: Subclass only (parent Warder): unlocks after two other subclasses reach 75 (forums); a subclass starts at 40, so the 1-39 bands do not apply. Role: rapier melee support with party "instinct" burst buffs and curse debuffs.
Only one Inspector "instinct" (Appetite 1476 / Protection Instinct 1478 / Vampiric Impulse 1477 / Magic Impulse 1479 / Soul Harmony 1480) is active at a time (shared INSTINCT slot).
pmfun lists soul costs (instincts 5 souls, curses 2 to 3, Restoration 1). The datapack has no soul cost on these. Trust the datapack: they are MP-only.

rows.trig: Party "instinct" (one at a time, 15 s, 5 min reuse): Appetite for Destruction: party P.Atk/crit rate/crit dmg +30 to 50%. At boss or raid engage, or at the start of a big pull in a melee party.

when.text: party HP drops sharply or a raid AoE is coming; only one instinct at a time

rows.trig: Party "instinct": Protection Instinct: party P.Def/M.Def up. When party HP drops sharply or a raid AoE is coming. Use it instead of Appetite.

when.text: melee party with low HP and no healer; only one instinct at a time

rows.trig: Party "instinct": Vampiric Impulse: melee absorb HP. Melee party with low HP and no healer.

when.text: mage-heavy party at burst time; only one instinct at a time

rows.trig: Party "instinct": Magic Impulse: party M.Atk/Cast Spd/M.Crit. Mage-heavy party at burst time.
Heal: Restoration: 15 s HoT on an ally or self. When an ally has HP < 70%.
Heal: Restoration Impact: requires Restoration on the target, consumes it for a % Max HP heal. When an ally has HP < 40% and Restoration is on them.
